_about: Every word the page shows that is not mission text (missions.json) or a uniform's name (uniforms.json). Keys named in the core's HUD (prompts, toasts with @, said_key) are looked up here.
title: Gatecrasher
subtitle: A third-person stealth game. One outpost, two portals, one silenced pistol, and the Memphis Mule.
credit: Art drawn in TikZ. Sound synthesized in the browser. The page loads only its own files.
no_webgl: This browser has no WebGL 2, so the game cannot draw. Try a current Chrome, Firefox or Safari.
uniform_note: How well each uniform blends into each ground, in camo index points. Change uniform in the field with U.
cause_shot: Shot. One bullet is all it takes.
cause_fell: A fall from that height kills.
graceland_lead: Every soldier you send up on a balloon lands here and goes to work. The more staff, and the better, the more each unit gives you on the next mission.
roster_empty: Nobody yet. Knock a soldier out, then press G beside him outdoors.
intel_none: Nothing yet. Grab a soldier from behind (F) and press E, hold one up at gunpoint (aim at him close up), or tie one to the mule (Y) and press E.
riding: Riding: you can be seen and heard from far off. J: get down
mule_full: The mule is already carrying someone.
vance_on_mule: Vance is on the mule. He'll carry him out.
use_talk_mule: E: interrogate the man on the mule
use_stash: E: put him in the locker
hold_options: F: choke out   X: kill   C: throw down
held_up_keep: Hands up: keep your gun on him (right mouse). E: interrogate   F: grab
lz_not_done: The helicopter will not come until the objective is done.
talk_marks: "There's... there's more of us. Over there." (Soldiers nearby marked.)
talk_alone: "I'm on my own out here, I swear."
held_up: "Don't shoot! Don't shoot!" (He drops his rifle.)
prisoner_out: Vance is on his way home.
radio_woke: Radio: "HQ, I was knocked out. Someone's inside the wire."
radio_held_up: Radio: "HQ, I was held up at gunpoint. Intruder inside the wire!"
radio_found: Radio: "Found one of ours out cold. Sweep the area."
radio_body: Radio: "Man down! We've got a body!"
portal_seen: An elite saw your portal and shut it.
mule_no_target: Point at a soldier for the mule to ram.
mule_far: The mule is too far away. Whistle for him (H).
tie_nothing: Nobody down to tie to the mule.
fulton_roof: No sky here: a balloon needs open air.
controls: Aim (hold on a soldier to mark him; close up, he puts his hands up)
CQC: grab from behind, or disarm and throw from the front
Use: pick up, put down, lockers, cage, case; interrogate (in a hold, held up, pinned at gunpoint, or on the mule)
Mule: ram the soldier you point at
Put a downed soldier, or Vance, on the mule; or take him off
Ride the mule, or get down (fast, but very noticeable)
